items.title: RH-ISAC Report: Familiar Fraud Tactics Expected to Arrive Through AI-Driven Traffic This Holiday Season
items.summary: RH-ISAC, the Retail & Hospitality Information Sharing and Analysis Center, released its 2026 Holiday Threat Trends report, which examines how agentic commerce is entering the holiday shopping season. According to the report, the RH-ISAC intelligence team assesses with moderate confidence that the most agentic commerce risk this season will come from existing fraud types, such as card testing, account takeover, and checkout page card theft, delivered through a growing volume of AI-driven web traf
